onset.Description: Marker position (s) from the start of the recording, as stored in the AnyWave marker file

duration.Description: Marker duration (s) as stored in the AnyWave marker file (0 = instantaneous)

trial_type.Description: AnyWave marker label, verbatim (e.g. '43Hz D08-D09 0.6mA; body perception' = 43 Hz stimulation of bipolar contacts D08-D09 at 0.6 mA with the clinical response; 'SPES D08 D09'; prestim/stim/poststim = authors' analysis windows); 'spes_gate' = the stretch where the TRIG channel is at its lower level, the stimulator-on gate (one in this run, 11.570-311.532 s; it spans all 20 single pulses, the first 0.7 ms after it opens and the last 14.96 s before it closes, and does not mark the individual pulses, which are in derivatives/stimartefact)

value.Description: AnyWave marker value field (n/a when the file stored -1)

targets.Description: AnyWave marker target channels, if any

Levels.analysis_ades_mrk: <recording>.ades.mrk (markers added by the authors for analysis windows)
Levels.acquisition_mrk;analysis_ades_mrk: marker present, identical, in both marker files (one row since 30 Oct 2026)
Levels.TRIG: decoded from the recorded TRIG channel: the TRIG channel has two levels; its lower level (0.000219 in header units) is the stimulator-on gate: in the HFS run its six 5.05-s stretches are the six 43 Hz trains, in the SPES run its one stretch (11.570-311.532 s) spans the 20 single pulses (code/fix-20261030/events_dedup_trig.py)
